oP.role: secondary/exactness: Q0 + B's 16 fresh points, baseline

pK.role: secondary/attribution: the 16-byte compact table without the filter (slot size alone)

pP.role: baseline: the probe-pipeline producer (claude/n83-probe-pipeline: lift_scan + Feistel order + prefetched root-table probes) on the 32-byte-slot 4 GiB root table

pT.role: candidate: pP's scan with the two-level root table: a 32 MiB register-blocked Bloom filter (5 bits in one 64-bit word per key) in front of 16-byte exact slots (2 GiB)

pT29.role: secondary/size: the candidate with a 64 MiB filter (2^29 bits)

pTaa.role: A/A control: a second candidate arm

pX.role: planted positive control: the candidate plus, for every probe the filter rejects, a prefetched and discarded lookup of the same key in the compact table (the big-table access the filter removes); probes and relation are pT's, every such lookup must find nothing

rT.role: A's tuned rho (Fold/64/DP6, crypto 770f6a69; reconcile rT770), the strongest one-target rho measured at n=83; one process per primary point; gap reference and scalar cross-check

current_baseline: the probe-pipeline producer, claude/n83-probe-pipeline @ ddbb86a9c (protocol frozen, run 38822490448 in flight when this protocol froze; its result is not used here). The baseline arm pP is that producer's prefetch loop on its 32-byte-slot table (make_online_source.py checks the probe-pipeline derivation against its frozen digest and leaves scan_state128_pipelined and RootTable128 unchanged); it runs in the same binary and job as the candidate. claude/n83-state-fold (run 38819494806, in flight) is not included: the filter takes the big table off ~97.6% of probes, so the fold's halved capacity no longer bears on the lookup; combining them is a later step.

decision_rule.invalid: any gate, identity check or control fails, or any primary point lacks a valid row in any of the four decision IC arms (pP, pT, pTaa, pX) or the tuned rho: no verdict; every row is preserved. A failed secondary arm (pK, pT29) is reported and does not invalidate
decision_rule.primary: improvement iff the 95% lower bound of R_m exceeds 1; regression iff its upper bound is below 1; otherwise not_separated
decision_rule.ratchet: a primary improvement makes probe pipeline + two-level root table the new n=83 one-target baseline, recorded with R_m, R_g, the S_rho delta, the cold and setup change and the tuned-rho gap
decision_rule.scope: Tier 1 instance scope, one runner. Not a claim to beat rho: the tuned-rho gap is distance remaining.
decision_rule.secondaries: R_g, the slice bootstrap, the attribution and size arms, setup/cold and the Q0 + 16 fresh block are reported; they never change the primary verdict or the ratchet

design.host: one fresh GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 runner (Tier 1 instance scope); every run one process pinned to one execution CPU (minimum of the affinity mask), clean environment, RAYON/KIC threads 1; all arms interleaved in one job; THP as the runner sets it (recorded)
design.process_model: each IC arm is one process per 64-point slice (17 for O): setup (index build with the arm's table layout and filter, table load and verification, bijection self-test) once, then each target with its own one-target online interval and no target-dependent work shared between targets
design.runtime_estimate: build+tests 20-30 min; log-table check ~2 min; P: 6 x (30-45 s setup + 64 x 0.15-0.6 s) + 64 rho x 1-3 s = 8-12 min per slice, 6 slices 50-75 min; O: 2 x 1-2 min; diagnostic profiler ~4 min; total about 1.3-2.0 h
design.within_segment_order: make_schedule.py's seeded shuffles (P: 2026104100 + s over the six IC processes and the 64 rho runs; O: 2026104300 + b)

gates: isolated_bench Tier 1 counters per run: exit 0, no timeout, verified=1, binary digest unchanged, no memory events; contention flags recorded and reported, never used to drop rows

every IC process: verified cached table on the frozen base, 29,880,000 states, the requested canonicalizer, order, probe pipeline, root-table layout and filter size reported in summary and every record, 29,878,182 root keys in 2^27 slots, KIC_ROOT_BLOOM off, no start override, Feistel bijection self-test passed, full-scan index build, five phases sum to each online interval, setup ends before the first online interval
every filter target record: relation checks <= filter passes <= probes; every record: no key the filter rejected is found in the table (planted_rejected_found = 0; pX looks every rejected key up)
primary exactness on every point: all six IC arms have identical probes and relation
one scalar per primary point across all IC arms and the tuned rho; every scalar replays as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle
Q0 + 16 fresh: oP and oT reproduce the archived Feistel probes and relation (run 38786433493's), scalars equal the archived ones and replay; Q0 equals the validation sidecar
multiplicity: one primary statistic; controls are pass/fail gates; secondaries are reported, never decide

online.factor_log_table_policy: B's archived table; re-verified before any timing by ../koblitz-n83-reconcile-20261014/verify_log_table.py in the pinned pure-Python oracle; every IC process additionally verifies all [L_j]G = R_j before target work
online.online_interval: producer's own clock: target_query_begin .. recovery_check_end, five exclusive phases; the Feistel order, the canonicalizer, the probe pipeline and the filter tests run inside the interval; index build (including the compact table and the filter build), log-table load and verification, the order's bijection self-test and process launch are outside
online.primary_targets_file: inputs/primary_targets.json (make_targets.py; role tablefilter-primary-v1, seeds 0..383; new role, no scalar known, disjoint from Q0, B's fresh points, the 384 scan-order held-out points, the 576 combined primary points, the 384 probe-pipeline primary points and the 16 state-fold cold points)

power.population: the 384 old held-out targets' measured Feistel full-scan online times (run 38786433493) over the mean measured full / lift_scan ratio (run 38776966036), inputs/power_prior.json; per-point effect spread from the 16 lift_scan ratios; noise sigma 0.02 per target and 0.01 per process
power.rule: power - 2 * sqrt(power * (1 - power) / trials) >= 0.80 in the 1.03 scenario; then at least the design floor of 384 points

profile.status: diagnostic, cloud-agent VM; chose the design, is not evidence of a speedup

summary.reading: Prefetch does not overlap lookups into the 2-4 GiB tables (lookup-only: prefetched about as slow as unprefetched; in situ ~140 ns per probe remain), halving the slot to 16 bytes changes almost nothing, and 4 KiB pages make the big tables much slower while the 32 MiB filter is unchanged and its prefetches do overlap. The limit is address translation for a working set far beyond TLB reach (page walks whose own entries miss the caches, few walks in flight), not bytes per slot; a small filter whose translations stay resident removes it for the ~97.6% of probes it rejects.

question: On the probe-pipeline n=83 a=1 K600 one-target IC (lift_scan + Feistel order + prefetched root-table probes), does a two-level root table (a 32 MiB blocked filter that rejects most misses before 16-byte exact slots are touched) lower the one-target online time on new public points, with probes, relation and scalar unchanged?

statistics.S: S_rho = (mean IC online ms / tuned-rho ms per walk step) / sqrt(r), ms per step = median over all rT runs of online_ms / walk_steps; S_probe = mean probes / sqrt(r); for pP and pT, with the delta pT - pP; the cold S_rho (mean cold ms instead of online) is reported too
statistics.aa: pT / pTaa, ratio of means, seed 2026104530
statistics.also_reported: R_g = gm pP / gm pT (paired geometric mean, seed 2026104501); probe ratio; per-arm summaries, ns/probe, mean probes / law and filter false-positive rate; R_m bootstrapped over the 64-point slices and per slice (sensitivity, seed 2026104550)
statistics.bootstrap: random.Random(seed); 10,000 resamples with replacement of the primary points; sorted; 95% interval = indices 250 and 9749
statistics.planted: pX / pT, ratio of means, seed 2026104532
statistics.primary: R_m = mean pP / mean pT, online_ms over all 384 primary points, seed 2026104500
statistics.rho_gap: tuned rho / IC for pP and pT on the same primary points, means and geometric means (seeds 2026104560-2026104563)
statistics.secondaries: Q0 + 16 fresh: oP / oT on the 16 fresh points (seed 2026104610) and Q0's two times
statistics.secondary_arms: pP / pK (slot size alone, seed 2026104534), pK / pT (the filter over the compact table, seed 2026104536), pT / pT29 (filter size, seed 2026104538)
statistics.setup_and_cold: per process: setup_ms (process start to setup complete), index build, filter build, peak RSS; per primary point: cold = its slice process's setup + its online time; ratios pP / pT of mean setup over the 6 slice processes (reported, no interval) and of mean cold over the points (seed 2026104540)

success_criterion: AGENTS.md 'Success criterion: iterative improvement of the index-calculus baseline': a verified, measured improvement over the current IC baseline under a protocol frozen before timing; each landed improvement becomes the new baseline with its delta.
